description: State-level emergency department visit percentages from National Syndromic Surveillance Program

activity_level_thresholds._comment: Simplified thresholds for deriving activity level from % ED visits. CDC uses historical percentiles; these are approximations.

notes.relationship_to_delphi: Same underlying NSSP data but state-level only (not MSA). Used for state context and as Delphi API redundancy.
notes.dataset_note: Repointed from rdmq-nq56 (CDC repurposed that ID into a trajectories/trends table) to vutn-jzwm (NSSP ED Visits - COVID-19/Flu/RSV/Combined), which exposes geography + pathogen + percent_visits + week_end. National geography label is 'United States'. There is no visit_type column.
